home.subtitle: Freelance web developer in Grenoble. I build your custom website, from the first call to launch.

about.title: One
about.description: I'm Téo, a freelance web developer in Grenoble. For 4 years I've been building websites and tools for independents, small businesses and research labs. You talk directly to the person building your site: no agency, no subcontracting. I deliver a fast, clean site that you can keep growing, with or without me. Alongside that, I'm finishing a computer science engineering degree at IMT Nord Europe.
about.quote: My goal: a website that brings you customers, not one that sleeps on the internet.

localSeo.intro: I'm a freelance web developer in Grenoble and I build websites for small businesses in the city and across Isère. No template bought and filled in a hurry: each site is designed and coded for your business, made for phones first, and built so that people looking for what you offer near them find you on Google.
localSeo.whoIntro: Most of my clients are businesses of one to ten people who have neither the time nor the wish to become web experts. What a site has to do for them changes from one trade to the next:

trades.link: website for a restaurant in Grenoble
trades.text: a menu that reads well on a phone and is easy to update, opening hours, directions and a simple way to book a table.

trades.link: website for a holiday cottage near Grenoble
trades.text: photos that make people want to stay, an availability calendar and direct booking, to rely less on platforms and their fees.

trades.link: website for a tradesperson in Grenoble
trades.text: your work in photos, the area you cover and quote requests that land straight in your inbox.

trades.link: website for a shop in Grenoble
trades.text: your products, opening hours and address in plain sight, with a catalogue or in-store pickup if you need it.

trades.link: website for a freelancer in Grenoble
trades.text: consultants, therapists, coaches or other professionals: a clear presentation of your approach and online appointment booking.

included: A custom design in your colours, adapted to phones, tablets and computers.
Text structured for local search: titles, descriptions and the details Google shows in its results.
Fast pages: optimised images and lightweight code, because a visitor on a phone won't wait.
A contact, quote or booking form that emails you every request.
Launch with domain name and HTTPS, with hosting and support included for 30 days.
If you'd like, an admin area to change your text, photos and prices yourself.
steps: A free 30-minute call to understand your business, your clients and what the site should get them to do.
A detailed quote within 24 hours, item by item, with a fixed price: no surprises on the invoice.
The mockup, which you approve before I write a line of code, then development, which you follow on a test link.
Launch, a walkthrough so you can edit your content, then ongoing support if you want it.
localSeo.area: I work with clients in Grenoble, Meylan, Échirolles, Saint-Martin-d'Hères, Voiron and throughout Isère, from the Grésivaudan to the Vercors. For a first meeting we can meet in the Grenoble area or talk by video call, whichever you prefer. The rest works very well remotely, which is also how I work with clients elsewhere in France.
localSeo.freelanceTitle: Why a freelancer rather than an agency
localSeo.freelance: At an agency, the person who sells you the project isn't the one who builds it, and every middleman ends up in the price. With me, you talk directly to the developer: your requests don't get lost along the way, decisions are made quickly and you always know where your site stands. I only take on a few projects at a time, which lets me keep to the deadlines I give. And the site is yours: code, domain name and content are in your name, and you can keep growing it with me or with someone else.
